description: Additional schema info consumed by `mj codegen` (CodeGenLib additionalSchemaInfo). Declares core IS-A (Table-Per-Type) inheritance relationships and SubtypeSelector attributes so CodeGen sets Entity.ParentID and Entity.SubtypeSelector, mirrors inherited fields as virtual fields on child entities, and JOINs parent tables in child base views.

ISARelationships._comment: Comment IS-A Conversation (Table-Per-Type): Comment.ID PK is also an FK to Conversation.ID.
FieldSuggestion IS-A Comment (Table-Per-Type, 2-level IS-A chain under Conversation): FieldSuggestion.ID PK is also an FK to Comment.ID.
